offers_products.reason: Supplies diabetes, sleep, wound care, urology, ostomy products and home medical equipment through Apria and Byram.

offers_services.reason: Home respiratory and sleep care, patient support and education, and equipment servicing delivered to patients at home.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Patients at home choose and receive diabetes, sleep and respiratory supplies and care, though insurers often pay.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Works with providers and insurers, which pay for and refer patients; payers are central to the business.

recurring_revenue.reason: Recurring resupply of diabetes, ostomy, urology and sleep supplies plus monthly equipment rentals for chronic conditions.

cyclical_demand.reason: Chronic-condition medical supplies and home respiratory care are needs patients cannot easily postpone in a recession.

big_ticket.reason: Small, frequent supply shipments and monthly rentals, not large infrequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes mainly from medical products, equipment rentals and logistics rather than staff time and skill.

large_customers.reason: End users are individual patients; payers are large insurers, but the patient is the main buyer.

asset_heavy.reason: Needs rental equipment fleets like ventilators and CPAP, distribution centers, branches and delivery vehicles nationwide.

notes: Formerly Owens & Minor; the current business is mainly the Apria and Byram home-care segments, and payer mix is inferred.
